description: Versioned rich-text sanitizer data contract. The Go write sanitizer and browser client sanitizer must accept exactly these tags, attributes, and URL schemes, then pass the shared hostile corpus. Runtime implementations live outside this package. resume.schema.json pins this version and mirrors urlSchemes for structured URL fields; JSON Schema cannot enforce the HTML tag or attribute rules. See docs/design/security.md.

forbidden.description: Explicit high-risk cases. The allowlist also rejects every tag and attribute not admitted above.

linkHardening.description: Every emitted <a> gets rel="noopener noreferrer" regardless of the source value.
